pages.title: Ordinal Stone
pages.text: Stone laid down in well-ordered strata. Every layer has a next one, and every collection of layers has a first; even the infinite stacks have a successor waiting above them. It splits cleanly along those order lines.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The terrain in this dimension was stacked like the ordinals: 1, 2, 3, then omega, then omega plus one. I took a pick to it and found each layer gave way in exactly the expected order.
Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Transfinite Hierarchy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Aleph Glass, Cardinal Shard, Hilbert Brick, Omega, Ordinal Shard.
